pages.title: 대형폐기물 처리신청 < 기타 민원서비스 < 민원안내 < 천안시청

observation.method: Fresh independent anonymous Playwright Chromium public-page observation, actual ariaSnapshot and original DOM ancestry. Library DOM read through a CDP isolated world. No product source, tests or product output read or run.
conditions: DOMContentLoaded plus 1600ms; selected controls had layout boxes and were not CSS-hidden, inert or aria-hidden.
No authentication, editable values, text entry, selection, submission, download or original task event execution.
Readonly task focus/hit-test and three public destination GET checks appear separately in docs/evidence/run002/blind-v4-observations.json.
limitations: Small selected public-control reconstructions only; no full site copy, CSS/media, application scripts, authenticated state or actual extension execution.
Original ancestor tags, IDs, classes, fixed accessible labels and hrefs are retained; omitted unrelated context and original geometry can affect live behavior.
Inline onclick presence uses an inert return-false marker; original JavaScript href text is retained but handlers are not copied. Offline fixtures use script-src none; object-src none CSP metadata.
Readonly focus and center hit tests are limited source reach checks, not a full keyboard or assistive-technology audit.
File links are locate-only; no requested download or actual application/submission action was executed.

task.instruction: 천안시 폐기물관리에 관한 조례 [별표6] 원본 링크 위치를 찾으세요. 다운로드·폐기물 신청·결제·조회 정보 입력은 실행하지 않습니다.
task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: 신청하기와 결과 조회는 실제 관찰한 일반 HTTP 링크이므로 공개 진입 위치로 navigate를 주석했다. 접수 완료·결제·조회 정보 제출을 뜻하지 않는다.
조례 별표의 직접 FileDown 링크는 다운로드를 실행하지 않고 원본 위치로 안내하는 locate이다. 입력 폼·사용자 값·신청 결과는 수집하지 않았다.
